What am I supposed to do now?!
???: Come on!

He pulled out a gun! {{punch}}I immediately raised my hands up and observed in fear as a dark figure approached me…
???: I’m gonna ask last time pal, Who sent you?! If I hear anything else than a name I pop you! 
You: N-No one sent me! I’m just-
